about:
LA Packaging, based in Yorba Linda, California, was founded in 1984 by Edward Loritz Sr. with a commitment to supplying American-made hinged-lid plastic containers at affordable prices. The company continues his legacy, manufacturing its product lines domestically using medical-grade, Class VI polypropylene that meets REACH, RoHS, and FDA requirements.

The firm specializes in injection-molded clarified polypropylene, polyethylene, and ESD-safe containers and vials, offering customization through hot stamping and custom labeling. Its production capabilities have expanded to serve customers across North America, Europe, and Asia, with all manufacturing performed in the United States.

LA Packaging serves the electronic, medical, pharmaceutical, industrial, food, and laboratory sectors. It also operates two direct-to-customer e-commerce sites: lacontainerstore.com for bulk orders and esdplasticcontainers.com for small-quantity, no-minimum purchases of ESD-inhibiting containers.

The company differentiates itself by using higher-cost, medical-grade polypropylene that avoids harmful chemicals and leaching, and by providing personalized service including Net 30 terms and direct phone support.
